$comment: The layout ratchet's allowlist (ADR-0063). `unconverted`: generator source that still types its own layout; each entry names what it emits and the writer PR that converts it, and is removed when that PR lands (the test fails while a converted file keeps its entry). `exempt`: source that writes text which is not generated code; each says why. Neither list may grow: test/layout-ratchet.test.ts compares it with the copy at the branch's merge base.

unconverted.codegen-ts/src/client-directive.ts: Prepends the "use client" directive to a finished module by string concatenation. It is the after-render seam the shipped and reference generators call (and owned 1.2 copies with them), and it must keep a body's own blank lines byte for byte, which the writer's blank-line requests would collapse. Ruled at the writer close-out (W-TS-9): it stays as it is until that seam is redesigned.
unconverted.codegen-ts/src/generators/agent-schema-p: Emits the agent schema markdown page; template strings with hand-typed line breaks and indentation. Converts with the docs and markdown writer PR; its output is documentation, not code an adopter edits, so it goes after the code generators.

exempt.codegen-ts/src/generators/contract-schem: Writes the contract-schema generator's JSON Schema documents as JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a final newline. The layout is the JSON serializer's, so there is no code to lay out and no writer to move to.
exempt.codegen-ts/src/generators/openapi-file.t: Writes the openapi generator's OpenAPI document as JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a final newline. The layout is the JSON serializer's, so there is no code to lay out and no writer to move to.
exempt.codegen-ts/src/overwrite-policy.ts: Writes the codegen tool-state files (the per-package manifests under .metaobjects/.gen-state/.hashes/ and the engine stamp) as JSON.stringify output plus a final newline. That is a data file the runner owns, not generated code, so it has no writer to move to.
exempt.codegen-ts/src/poet.ts: The vendored ts-poet printer, the engine the writer replaces: its import emitter prints the import lines of a Code file. It is retired when the last generator moves to the writer, not converted to it.
exempt.codegen-ts/src/reference/contract-schema: The reference (ejectable) copy of the contract-schema generator; writes JSON Schema documents as JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a final newline. The layout is the JSON serializer's, so there is no code to lay out and no writer to move to.
exempt.codegen-ts/src/reference/openapi.ts: The reference (ejectable) copy of the openapi generator; writes the OpenAPI document as JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus a final newline. The layout is the JSON serializer's, so there is no code to lay out and no writer to move to.
